name: io.github.swnotmetal/koma-gate-mcp
title: Koma Gate MCP
description: Classifies prompt injection, jailbreaks, and out-of-scope user input before agents act on it.

environmentVariables.name: KOMA_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LLM provider: openai, anthropic, google, deepseek, or ollama (default: google)

environmentVariables.name: KOMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional model override for the selected provider

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key (used by the default provider)
